title: What MLLMs Learn about When they Learn about Multimodal Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2510.01719v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Evaluation of multimodal reasoning models is typically reduced to a single accuracy score, implicitly treating reasoning as a unitary capability. We introduce MathLens, a benchmark of textbook-style geometry problems that exposes this assumption by operationally decomposing performance into perception, reasoning, and multimodal-specific components. Each problem is derived from a symbolic specification and accompanied by visual diagrams, text-only variants, multimodal questions, and targeted perceptual probes, enabling controlled measurement of each component. Using this decomposition, we show that common training strategies are associated with systematically different capability profiles that are invisible under aggregate accuracy. Across the models we study, reinforcement learning primarily improves perceptual grounding and robustness to diagram variation, while our analysis suggests that textual SFT yields gains through reflective

translated_title: 多模态大语言模型在学习多模态推理时究竟学到了什么
translated_abstract: 对多模态推理模型的评估通常被简化为单一的准确率分数，这隐含地将推理视为一种单一的能力。我们提出了MathLens，这是一个由教科书式几何问题组成的基准，通过将模型性能可操作地分解为感知、推理和多模态特定组件，来揭示上述假设的局限。每个问题均源自符号化规范，并配有可视化图形、纯文本变体、多模态问题和针对性的感知探针，从而能够对各组件进行受控测量。利用这种分解方法，我们表明常见的训练策略与系统性不同的能力特征相关联，而这些差异在总体准确率指标下是不可见的。在我们研究的模型中，强化学习主要提升了感知基础能力和对图形变化的鲁棒性，而我们的分析表明文本SFT则通过反思性
tldr: 该论文提出MathLens几何推理基准，将多模态推理性能分解为感知、推理和多模态组件，揭示了强化学习与文本SFT等常见训练策略会产生在总体准确率下不可见的系统性不同能力特征。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces MathLens, a geometry benchmark that decomposes multimodal reasoning performance into perception, reasoning, and multimodal-specific components, revealing that common training strategies such as reinforcement learning and textual SFT yield systematically different capability profiles that are invisible under aggregate accuracy.
